air.kid: What we breathe. The Moon has none, so sound can't travel there.

seismometer.kid: A machine that feels the ground shake.

reflector.kid: Glass cubes that bounce light straight back.

descent stage.kid: Eagle's bottom half, the part that stayed.

laser.kid: A very thin, very bright beam of light.

crater.kid: A round hole made when a space rock hits the ground.

blueberries.kid: Tiny iron-rich balls on Mars, not real fruit.

solar panels.kid: Flat wings that turn sunlight into power.

dust storm.kid: Wind lifting so much dust that it hides the Sun.

lunar module.kid: The small spacecraft that landed on the Moon. This one was named Eagle.

solar wind.kid: A stream of tiny bits blowing out from the Sun.

moonquake.kid: A shake of the Moon's ground, like an earthquake.
